title: Reports of Unauthorised Bank Transaction taking Place despite Absence of Alerts on Customer's Telephone Records
what_it_is: Reports of Unauthorised Bank Transaction taking Place despite Absence of Alerts on Customer's Telephone Records

sections.label: Police reports and FIDReC cases
sections.summary: The Singapore Police Force has received no such report since 2021, and FIDReC knows of two disputed SMS OTP cases since July 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Singapore Police Force has not received any such report since 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Financial Industry Disputes Resolution Centre (FIDReC) is aware of two cases since July 2022 where the use or receipt of SMS OTP by the customer is disputed.

sections.label: MAS fair treatment expectation
sections.summary: MAS expects banks to treat customers fairly in all disputes over unauthorised transactions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: MAS expects banks to treat customers fairly in all cases of disputes over unauthorised transactions.

sections.label: FIDReC dispute and legal options
sections.summary: Customers may lodge disputes with FIDReC, and if unsatisfied with its outcome, may seek legal advice on going to Court.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Any customer may, if they wish, lodge the dispute with FIDReC for mediation and adjudication.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: If they are not satisfied with the FIDReC outcome, they can consider seeking legal advice on whether to pursue their case in Court.

sections.label: Banks exploring biometric authentication
sections.summary: Banks are exploring expanding biometric technology with liveness test alongside passwords and OTP for authentication.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Banks are also exploring expanding the use of biometric technology with liveness test in addition to passwords and OTP as a means of authentication.

sections.label: MAS work on authentication measures
sections.summary: MAS is working with banks on various authentication measures, including SMS OTP, and they are experimenting with different users as technology evolves.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: When is MAS going to require the banks to use more secure methods besides SMS OTP, for example, using the app-based OTPs?

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The short answer is that MAS is working with the banks on a variety of authentication measures, including SMS OTP, and they are experimenting with different users as the technology evolves.
